bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Vertical VPA focuses on the linear relationship between total volume and price over time using horizontal bars along the X-axis, whereas Horizontal Volume Profile (VAP) reveals the density and distribution of volume across specific price levels along the Y-axis.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Vertical Volume Price Analysis (VPA): Focuses on the linear relationship between total volume and price over time... Horizontal Volume Profile (VAP): Focuses on the density and distribution of volume across specific price levels.

facts.statement: Volume at Price (VAP) is designed strictly as a supporting tool to enhance traditional VPA by providing an internal profile of volume concentration, rather than replacing linear volume-price analysis.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The way to use this methodology is as an enhancement to the classic VPA approach, and NOT to replace it in any way.

facts.statement: High-density nodes appear on the VAP histogram as extended horizontal bars marking price regions of massive accumulation or distribution, painting visible platforms of support and ceilings of resistance directly onto the chart.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: High-density nodes appear on the VAP histogram as long, extended horizontal volume bars... They mark price regions where massive accumulation or distribution took place... solid platforms of support or ceilings of resistance.

facts.statement: Low-volume nodes appear as very short horizontal bars on the VAP histogram indicating minor price congestion where little trading activity occurred, allowing future price action to pass through them rapidly with minimal resistance.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Low-volume nodes appear as very short horizontal bars on the VAP histogram, indicating price ranges where little trading activity occurred... if future price action re-enters, the market can pass through it rapidly.

facts.statement: While long consolidation phases naturally accumulate high VAP volume, generating ultra-high VAP volume over a very short duration signals a major anomaly and heavy insider distribution or stopping volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: If a very short-duration consolidation phase generates ultra-high or extreme VAP volume, alarm bells ring. This signals heavy insider activity (such as aggressive selling/distribution or stopping volume) concentrated in a narrow price band.

facts.topic: Cutting Open the Volume Bar Analogy
facts.statement: Coulling compares VAP to a surgeon cutting open a single vertical volume bar to reveal whether volume concentration occurred at the bottom (buying) or the top (selling) of the price range.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: VAP acts like a surgeon cutting open the volume bar to reveal whether volume was built at the top (selling) or bottom (buying).

facts.statement: On a Microsoft 15-minute chart, a 1-day top consolidation built extreme VAP volume matching a 3-day bottom consolidation; this narrow-range volume spike signaled heavy insider distribution and preceded an immediate $1.40 price drop.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Microsoft (MSFT) 15-Minute Chart... The top consolidation lasted only 1 day but built extreme VAP volume matching the 3-day bottom level... signaled heavy insider selling/distribution... MSFT immediately plunged $1.40.

facts.topic: Procter & Gamble Daily Chart VAP Support
facts.statement: On the Procter & Gamble daily chart, a 3-month lower consolidation formed an extreme VAP support bar that provided long-term investors with a high-probability protective floor following a gap-up breakout.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Procter & Gamble (PG) Daily Chart... Over 6 months, a 3-month lower consolidation formed an extreme VAP support bar... PG broke out higher with a gap-up... lower VAP bar provided long-term investors with a high-probability protective floor.

facts.statement: Traders should utilize VAP node depth for risk management by placing protective stop losses safely behind deep VAP support shelves while tightening risk controls when price enters low-volume vacuum gaps.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: VAP node depth dictates trade management and stop-loss placement. Stops can be placed safely behind deep VAP support shelves, while shallow VAP nodes warn traders to tighten risk controls.

facts.statement: Coulling explains VAP by comparing it to a wholesaler tracking sales volume across different price points; rotating that price-versus-volume sales chart by 90 degrees creates the vertical VAP histogram.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The wholesaler lists a product at higher prices and monitors sales volume... Plotting sales volume against price and rotating the chart by 90 degrees creates the VAP vertical histogram.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
